scope: Offline code review and deterministic unit/integration/static checks; live work stopped by user.

fixes.name: Contradictory success claims
fixes.before: A failed command plus positive model flags could resolve execution.
fixes.after: Each step needs a successful unblocked attempt; blocked/manual/unobservable or malformed positive claims cannot resolve. Guards run at MCP recording and final judgment.

fixes.name: Exact approved values
fixes.before: Long success criteria were truncated at4000 characters and IDs at200, causing mismatch or collision.
fixes.after: Approved criteria and step/playbook identities stay exact; different long IDs remain independently required.

fixes.name: Evidence on runner exceptions
fixes.before: Runner exceptions could delete the workspace without persisting recorded commands and metric waits.
fixes.after: Recover the actual approved-snapshot journal, check current claim, persist FAILED evidence before cleanup; preserve error and prevent retrospective publication.

fixes.name: Agent catalog test assumptions
fixes.before: A stale test treated all scenarios as lacking AWS metadata.
fixes.after: Assert exact supplied metadata and unknown values only for missing fields; runtime region cannot replace source metadata. Production code and catalog unchanged.

rootContracts.failure: existing approved input digest/file-set mismatch; approval gate retained

offlineEvaluation.failure: no normalized result JSON files in tests/fixtures/results

validation.runtimeDependencyManifest: Pydantic declared directly; 95 resolved versions unchanged

limits: Successful command exit is necessary evidence, not deterministic proof of causal recovery or arbitrary natural-language success criteria.
External command/model/storage behavior in the new integration tests uses local doubles; this is not a live-model or deployed E2E pass.
No new deployment/model calls/fault injections after the user requested offline-first work; only existing live resources were cleaned up.
No baseline approval, result fabrication, fixture expectation reduction, remote Git push or current-demo-readiness claim.
deployedSource: Remains the pre-review deployment; new offline fixes are local commits only.
